excludedRows.reason: Task name, description, frequency and duration are blank.

timeMethod: Midpoint of source time range, rounded to the nearest 15 minutes. Longer scopes are split into visits of no more than 120 minutes.
ratioMethod: Midpoint of the largest named repair-price range divided by the midpoint service cost. A plus sign is retained in displayed prices; the comparison uses the two published figures even when higher costs are possible. One repair scenario is compared per task; unrelated repairs are not added together. Catch-up review/inspection prices are excluded. Complete service scopes are selected in descending ratio order within a 24-hour budget, with the displayed study visit counts. Ratios are price comparisons, not expected savings or failure probabilities.

tasks.name: Annual home inspection
tasks.description: General condition review and maintenance priorities.
tasks.frequency: Not fixed — 1/year would be Surfside’s chosen review schedule.
tasks.repairs: Another inspection: $300–500; repairs depend on findings. Source
tasks.benefit: Clear priorities and fewer unknowns.

tasks.name: Service HVAC system & replace air filters
tasks.description: Professional maintenance and accessible filter replacement.
tasks.repairs: AC repair: $150–650; compressor replacement: $1,300–2,500. Source
tasks.benefit: Consistent comfort; suitable filtration may help reduce airborne allergens.

tasks.name: Clean accessible vents & exhaust fans
tasks.description: Registers, bathroom fans, and exterior vent openings.
tasks.repairs: Replace an existing bathroom fan: $150–550 each. Source
tasks.benefit: Less dust buildup and better bathroom ventilation.

tasks.name: Clean & service kitchen appliances
tasks.description: Refrigerator coils, hood filters, dishwasher filter/seals, and connections.
tasks.frequency: Mixed schedules — some monthly; others model-dependent.
tasks.repairs: Dishwasher repair: $100–300; refrigerator repair: $125–500. Source
tasks.benefit: Cleaner appliances, fewer odors, dependable use.

tasks.name: Clean & service washing machine
tasks.description: Washer cleaning, connections, and straightforward hose replacement.
tasks.frequency: Monthly cleaning; hose replacement per manufacturer, such as every 5 years.
tasks.repairs: Washer repair: $100–400; replacement appliance: $700–1,300, before installation. Source
tasks.benefit: Fresher laundry equipment and fewer interruptions.

tasks.name: Clean & service dryer vent
tasks.description: Exhaust duct, connections, exterior termination, and airflow.
tasks.repairs: Dryer repair: $100–300; replacement appliance: $800–1,200, before installation. Cleaning, repairs
tasks.benefit: Faster drying and less lint-related overheating concern.

tasks.name: Inspect & service plumbing fixtures
tasks.description: Leak checks, toilets, pressure, aerators, showerheads, and bathroom caulking inspection.
tasks.frequency: Not fixed for the package; monthly water-bill review and prompt leak repairs.
tasks.repairs: Typical plumbing job: $125–450; separate water mitigation can cost $1,300–5,200. Plumbing, water mitigation
tasks.benefit: Reliable fixtures and fewer leak worries.

tasks.name: Service water heater
tasks.description: Appropriate flushing and accessible anode inspection.
tasks.frequency: 1/year for the cited conventional tank models.
tasks.repairs: Repair: $150–700; standard tank replacement: $600–3,100. Repair, replacement
tasks.benefit: Dependable hot water.

tasks.name: Replace water filters
tasks.description: Refrigerator and/or whole-house cartridges, flushing, and leak checks.
tasks.frequency: 2/year for the cited refrigerator filters; other systems model-dependent.
tasks.repairs: Whole-house filtration-system repair: $200–500. Source
tasks.benefit: Maintained filtration performance and applicable taste/odor benefits.

tasks.name: Clean & service gutters and drainage
tasks.description: Gutters, seams, fasteners, downspouts, discharge routes, and surface drains.
tasks.frequency: At least 2/year gutter/downspout inspections; cleaning as needed.
tasks.repairs: Soffit/fascia repair: $500–2,600; major foundation water-leak repair: $4,500–15,000+, if that damage exists. Fascia, foundation
tasks.benefit: Less overflow and pooling around the home.

tasks.name: Test & inspect sump pump
tasks.description: Pump, float switch, and discharge checks.
tasks.repairs: Pump repair: $200–870, excluding flood damage. Source
tasks.benefit: Confidence during wet weather.

tasks.name: Inspect roof, attic & crawl spaces
tasks.description: Visible roof, flashing, insulation, moisture, and pest concerns.
tasks.frequency: At least 2/year for roof checks; attic/crawl-space schedule property-specific.
tasks.repairs: Moderate roof/leak repair: $1,000–3,000, excluding unrelated interior restoration. Source
tasks.benefit: Earlier awareness of hidden problems.

tasks.name: Inspect & maintain exterior paint, caulking & trim
tasks.description: Finish/seal inspection and selected small paint touch-ups.
tasks.frequency: 1/year condition checks; repairs and touch-ups as needed.
tasks.repairs: Soffit/fascia repairs: $500–2,600. Source
tasks.benefit: Better appearance and pride of ownership.

tasks.name: Wash exterior siding, entry & paths
tasks.description: Suitable cleaning of siding/stucco and selected hardscape.
tasks.repairs: Catch-up washing: $250–800* for the same scope; surface restoration requires a separate assessment.
tasks.benefit: A cleaner, more welcoming exterior.

tasks.name: Trim vegetation & clear perimeter debris
tasks.description: Light trimming and removal of vegetation/debris near the home.
tasks.repairs: Published yard-cleanup pricing: approximately $125–400/visit, depending on scope. Source
tasks.benefit: Usable outdoor space and maintained clearance.

tasks.name: Inspect & maintain fences, gates, decks & walkways
tasks.description: Condition checks and minor accessible hardware adjustments.
tasks.repairs: Fence repair: $300–900; deck repair: $750–2,500. Fence, deck
tasks.benefit: Easier access and fewer loose components.

tasks.name: Inspect, clean & reseal concrete
tasks.description: Inspection, cleaning, and resealing selected surfaces.
tasks.repairs: Small driveway cracks/potholes: $100–400; major repairs/resurfacing: $600–3,000. Source
tasks.benefit: Better appearance and easier surface care.

tasks.name: Inspect & adjust irrigation
tasks.description: Zone operation, leaks, coverage, heads, and timer settings.
tasks.frequency: Monthly during use; seasonal schedule adjustments.
tasks.repairs: Irrigation repair: $100–400, excluding excess water charges. Source
tasks.benefit: More consistent watering and fewer puddles.

tasks.name: Inspect & service window and door weather seals
tasks.description: Seal checks, weep openings, and selected weatherstripping replacement.
tasks.repairs: Window-frame repair: $150–600; door-frame repair: $75–220. Source
tasks.benefit: Fewer drafts and improved comfort.

tasks.name: Inspect for storm damage, moisture & mold signs
tasks.description: Post-weather observations, moisture checks, and documentation.
tasks.repairs: Water mitigation: $1,300–5,200; mold remediation: $1,500–6,000 if needed. These scopes may overlap. Water, mold
tasks.benefit: Less uncertainty about dampness and mustiness.

tasks.name: Inspect chimney & fireplace and document condition
tasks.description: Routine specialist inspection and condition report.
tasks.frequency: At least 1/year inspection; cleaning as needed.
tasks.repairs: Minor repairs: $200–850; extensive repairs: $500–7,000. Inspection, repairs
tasks.benefit: Confidence in fireplace condition.

tasks.name: Check smoke alarms, CO alarms & fire extinguishers
tasks.description: Alarm tests, battery/date checks, and visual extinguisher checks.
tasks.repairs: Professionally installed combination smoke/CO detector: $140–360+ each. This is device replacement, not a value assigned to safety. Source
tasks.benefit: Working safety equipment and peace of mind.

tasks.name: Inspect electrical fixtures & test GFCIs
tasks.description: GFCI tests, visible outlets/switches, and outdoor lighting.
tasks.frequency: Monthly GFCI tests; other checks condition-dependent.
tasks.repairs: Outlet repair: $80–200 each. Inspection, repair
tasks.benefit: Reliable lighting and functioning protective devices.

tasks.name: Review emergency preparedness
tasks.description: Supplies, first aid, flashlights, and household plans.
tasks.repairs: Catch-up review: $25–80*; replacement supplies are additional and inventory-specific.
tasks.benefit: Readiness and less uncertainty during emergencies.

tasks.name: Inspect for pest activity & seal entry points
tasks.description: Visual warning signs and sealing selected accessible gaps.
tasks.repairs: Termite-damage repair: $300–2,000 minor, $2,000–15,000 moderate/major, excluding treatment. Source
tasks.benefit: Fewer pest intrusions and greater comfort.

tasks.name: Adjust doors, cabinet hardware & sliding doors
tasks.description: Hinges, alignment, latches, tracks, and compatible moving components.
tasks.repairs: Typical door repair: $132–372 per door. Source
tasks.benefit: Smoother operation and fewer daily frustrations.

tasks.name: Inspect & service garage door
tasks.description: Safety tests and accessible moving-part maintenance.
tasks.frequency: Monthly inspections/tests; 1/year specified lubrication under the cited guidance.
tasks.repairs: Typical repair: $150–350. Source
tasks.benefit: Convenient access and smoother operation.

tasks.name: Review & prioritize home maintenance list
tasks.description: Review outstanding items and agree on next actions.
tasks.repairs: Catch-up review: $20–55*; no separate standardized repair charge.
tasks.benefit: Less mental load and clearer next steps.
